newsitem.title: GERMANY: Boss says to pay special 1996 dividend.
newsitem.headline: Boss says to pay special 1996 dividend.

text.p: FRANKFURT, Feb 20 ( Reuter ) - German men's fashion retailer Hugo Boss AG said on Thursday it would pay a special dividend of 57 marks per share on 1996 results and increase by four marks per share its ordinary and preference share payouts.
Boss said the higher dividend payout recommendation, which must still receive shareholder approval, was due to improved business conditions.

In addition to the special payout, Boss said it would recommend a dividend of 45 marks per share on ordinary shares, up from 41 marks per share in 1995, and a dividend of 46.50 marks on preference shares compared with a dividend of 42.50 marks paid out in 1995.
